apps.name: Mornye
apps.description: Mornye (formerly SpotiFLAC Mobile) is an open-source music app for iOS: scan your own folders or stream from SMB, WebDAV, HTTP and Subsonic/OpenSubsonic servers, browse songs, albums, artists and playlists, edit metadata and artwork, and play FLAC and other high-resolution audio through a built-in player with a multiband equalizer, ReplayGain volume levelling, synced word-by-word lyrics and a sleep timer. Everything runs on the device; no account is needed.
apps.shortDescription: Local music library, FLAC player and tag editor

apps.name: uProVid
apps.description: uProVid is a build-it-yourself YouTube mod. Bring your own decrypted YouTube base IPA (local file or link), pick the tweaks you want - YouMod and YTLite resolve from their official upstream releases, anything else by direct .deb link - set the app name, bundle ID and version, and the Tweak Factory injects the selection with Cyan and publishes the result back to this source as a provenance-tagged release with digests. Until the first uProVid factory build ships (tag tweak-build/uprovid/* in this repository), the listing serves ASJTube 1.2.1 on YouTube 21.37.4 - the same publisher's ready-to-sideload YouTube enhancer with the YouPip / YouQuality / dislikes/privacy tweak stack - as a stand-in. Build one: python3 scripts/tweak_factory.py build (docs/TWEAK-FACTORY.md). Requires iOS 17.0+. Shares com.google.ios.youtube with the other YouTube mods: install one at a time.
apps.shortDescription: Your YouTube, your tweaks: base IPA + the mods you pick

apps.name: uYouEnhanced
apps.source: Community build of arichornlover/uYouEnhanced, mirrored on archive.org
apps.description: uYou is the best tweak for the YouTube app. uYouEnhanced is a modified version of qnblackcat's uYouPlus & MiRO92's uYou with even more features. Additional features include skipping sponsorships in videos, more PiP options, unlocking higher resolutions, disabling overlays, removing upsell alerts, dimming the UI, enabling the miniplayer, preventing notch issues, configuring A/B settings, and adding a timestamp button.
apps.publisher: Community build of arichornlover/uYouEnhanced, mirrored on archive.org

apps.name: YouTube Plus
apps.description: YouTube Plus (formerly YTLite) is a YouTube enhancer developed by dayanch96. This ready-to-sideload IPA is packaged by mrdrvt99/YouProEXTRA and offers features such as ad blocking, background playback, downloads, Picture-in-Picture and customizable controls. Features and compatibility can vary by release.
apps.shortDescription: Lightweight YouTube tweak with no ads and PiP

apps.name: YouPro
apps.description: YouPro is a YouTube modification tweak developed by alibusut. This community-distributed YouProEXTRA build includes additional player tweaks and controls. Features and bundled tweaks vary by release; the current publisher notes that downloads may work only partially and standalone iSponsorBlock is not included.

apps.name: YTKillerPlus
apps.description: YTKillerPlus is an advanced feature-packed YouTube tweak by iKarwan. It offers comprehensive ad blocking, background playback, high-speed downloads, PiP, custom player actions, OLED dark theme, and granular privacy controls.
apps.shortDescription: Advanced YouTube tweak with extensive controls

apps.name: YTKACE
apps.description: YTKACE is a free, open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS. No ads, background playback, video and audio downloads, SponsorBlock, Picture in Picture, player gestures and deep interface customization.

apps.name: YouMod
apps.description: YouMod is a YouTube tweak by Tonwalter888. This community-distributed YouProEXTRA IPA includes YouMod and additional player tweaks, such as picture-in-picture and quality controls. The distributor warns that bundled tweaks may be unstable on newer YouTube versions; see the release notes for the current features. Requires iOS 17.0+. Shares com.google.ios.youtube with the other YouTube mods: install one at a time.

apps.name: MaxTube
apps.description: MaxTube (formerly YTPlusM) is Mark02-2012's fork of YTPlus/YTLite, the enhancer for the YouTube app on iOS. On top of the YTPlus feature set — video/audio/thumbnail downloads, SponsorBlock, PiP, YTUHD, YouQuality, Return YouTube Dislike, YTABConfig, DontEatMyContent and over 100 configurable options without a subscription — MaxTube integrates ten extra tweaks: YTweaks, Gonerino, YouSpeed, YTLowContrastMode, VolumeBoostYT, YouGetCaption, YTPlaybackFix, YouChooseQuality, YouShare and PleaseDontStopTheMusic. Settings live inside YouTube under Settings.

apps.name: YTMusicUltimate
apps.description: YTMusicUltimate is a lightweight enhancer for YouTube Music by Dayanch96. It unlocks background audio playback, removes in-app advertisements, enables premium audio streaming quality, and provides customizable player themes.

apps.name: MaxMusic
apps.description: MaxMusic (formerly YTMUltimate+) is Mark02-2012's fork of Dayanch96's YTMusicUltimate for the YouTube Music app on iOS. It keeps everything YTMusicUltimate provides — no ads, background playback, download manager, audio quality selection — and adds Return YouTube Music Dislike, YouMusicPiP, YTMABConfig and VolumeBoostYT, plus fixed in-app downloads on newer YouTube Music versions. Settings live inside YouTube Music under Settings.

apps.name: UTM
apps.description:
Run real operating systems on your iPhone or iPad. UTM is an open-source (Apache-2.0) virtualization and emulation platform built on QEMU, capable of running Windows, Linux, classic Mac OS and dozens of other systems alongside your apps.

Highlights:
- QEMU v10.0.2 backend with support for dozens of CPU architectures (x86_64, ARM64, RISC-V, PowerPC and more)
- Improved machine wizard with well-tested configurations such as Windows, Ubuntu, RISC-V64 Ubuntu, classic Mac OS 8.x/9.x and Windows 95/98
- Custom keyboard shortcuts (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+Del) sent directly to the VM from the Keyboard menu
- App Intents automation with the Shortcuts app
- Liquid Glass design on iOS 26
- Import and export .utm virtual machine bundles via the Files app
- No jailbreak required; highest performance with JIT workarounds on supported iOS versions

apps.name: iNKillerPlus
apps.description: iNKillerPlus is a modified Instagram by iKarwan. Download posts, reels, stories and DM media, save profile pictures, block promoted posts and ads, toggle seen/unseen for stories and DMs, ghost typing, hide tabs, copy comments and bios, confirmation prompts before liking or calling, and a profile analyzer. iPadOS supported.
apps.shortDescription: Instagram with downloads, ghost mode and no ads

apps.name: TTKillerPlus
apps.description: TTKillerPlus is a modified TikTok by iKarwan. Download videos from the feed, stories and Explore, save photos and profile avatars, merge post photos with their music, block promoted posts and ads, toggle seen/unseen, hide tabs, browse the feed of a specific country, show country flags and post dates, and auto-like in live streams. iPadOS supported.
apps.shortDescription: TikTok with downloads, no ads and region switch

apps.name: Winston
apps.description: Winston is a beautiful open-source Reddit client for iOS built in SwiftUI, with themes, gestures, an inline media viewer and a fast comment thread reader. Because Reddit charges for API access, Winston asks you to create your own free Reddit API credentials on first launch.

apps.name: iTorrent
apps.description: iTorrent is a fully featured open-source torrent client for iOS. It keeps downloading in the background, integrates with the Files app, supports magnet links, sequential download and per-file selection, and ships a built-in VLC-based player with Picture in Picture, audio and subtitle tracks and playback speed control.
apps.shortDescription: Torrent client with a built-in player

apps.name: StikDebug
apps.description: StikDebug attaches a debugger to your sideloaded apps directly on device, which enables JIT for emulators and other apps that need it. It uses a pairing file and an on-device VPN loop, so no computer is required after the initial setup. Requires iOS 17.4 or newer.

apps.name: BHTwitter
apps.description: BHTwitter is a long-running tweak for X (formerly Twitter), published as a ready-to-sideload IPA. It hides promoted posts and ads, restores the chronological timeline as the default, and lets you download videos, GIFs and images straight from a post. It also adds Face ID / Touch ID app lock, custom fonts, undo posting, inline translation, direct saving of profile pictures and headers, confirmation prompts for likes and reposts, and switches for hiding the tabs and UI elements you never use.
apps.shortDescription: X (Twitter) with no ads, downloads and the chronological timeline

apps.name: LiveContainer
apps.description: LiveContainer runs other iOS apps inside itself instead of installing them, so a single app slot on your certificate can host many sideloaded apps and you stop burning through the 3-app limit. When JIT is available it bypasses codesigning entirely; otherwise guest apps are signed with the same certificate as LiveContainer. It supports multiple data containers per app, tweak injection, adding guest apps to the Home Screen, and multitasking windows on iPadOS 16 and later.
apps.shortDescription: Run iOS apps without actually installing them

apps.name: Feather
apps.description: Feather is a free on-device iOS and iPadOS application manager built with UIKit. Import your own developer or enterprise certificate to sign and install IPAs directly from the device, add AltStore-compatible repositories to browse and update apps, keep a library of signed and imported apps, and tweak bundle identifiers, display names, icons and injected dylibs per app - no computer or AltServer required.
apps.shortDescription: On-device app manager, signer and installer

apps.name: SideStore
apps.description: SideStore is a fork of AltStore that signs and refreshes sideloaded apps directly on the device. After a one-time pairing-file setup it renews 7-day certificates in the background using your own Apple ID and an anisette server, so apps stop expiring while you are away from a computer. It installs apps from any AltStore-compatible source, keeps them updated, and can back up and restore app data.
apps.shortDescription: AltStore fork that refreshes apps without a computer

apps.name: Aidoku
apps.description: Aidoku is a free and open-source manga reader for iOS and iPadOS with no ads and no tracking. Content comes from community-maintained source lists that you add yourself, so nothing is bundled with the app. It downloads chapters for offline reading, syncs library, history and settings through iCloud, supports external trackers, and offers paged, vertical and continuous reading modes with customisable layouts.

apps.name: Provenance
apps.description: Provenance is a multi-emulator front-end covering Atari, Bandai, NEC, Nintendo, Sega, SNK and Sony systems from a single library. It handles save states, cheats, MFi and native game controllers, Metal-based scaling filters, per-core settings, and imports your own ROMs and BIOS files through the Files app, iCloud or its built-in web uploader.

apps.name: Delta
apps.description: Delta is an all-in-one classic video game emulator for non-jailbroken iOS devices, developed by Riley Testut as the spiritual successor to GBA4iOS. It emulates the Nintendo systems (Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, Nintendo DS, Nintendo 64, SNES, NES) plus Sega Genesis and Game Gear, with save states and cheats, controller and Nintendo DS skin support, iCloud sync of saves, and full MFi/Bluetooth controller support.
apps.shortDescription: All-in-one retro emulator by Riley Testut

apps.name: PPSSPP
apps.description: PPSSPP is a fast and portable PlayStation Portable (PSP) emulator developed by Henrik Rydgård. It runs PSP games at up to double native resolution with anisotropic filtering and shader effects, supports save states anywhere, hardware controllers, and needs no BIOS file thanks to its high-level emulation approach.

apps.name: Yattee
apps.description: Yattee is a privacy-oriented, fully native video player for iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. It plays from user-configured Invidious or Piped backends and local video libraries, with SponsorBlock, chapters, background audio, Picture in Picture, subscriptions, and full keyboard and remote control support.

apps.name: Streamyfin
apps.description: Streamyfin is an open-source Jellyfin client for iPhone and iPad built with Expo and React Native. Stream your Jellyfin server's library with offline downloads, background audio, Picture in Picture, Chromecast, intro skipping, live TV, and an optional MPV-based player — no server plugins required.

apps.name: Spotube
apps.description: Spotube is an open-source, cross-platform music streaming client that combines Spotify's metadata — your playlists, albums, liked songs and recommendations — with community audio sources, so you can play your whole Spotify library without ads or telemetry. Includes lyrics and a plugin system for extending playback sources.

apps.name: Jellify
apps.description: Jellify is a free and open-source music player for Jellyfin, built with React Native. Browse and stream your Jellyfin music libraries on iPhone and iPad with a native interface, fast search, playlists, favorites and now-playing controls — available on the App Store and as sideload builds.
apps.shortDescription: Native Jellyfin music player for iOS

apps.name: Zeus
apps.description: Zeus is a free and open-source, self-custodial Bitcoin and Lightning wallet for iPhone and iPad. Connect the app to your own node (LND, Core Lightning, c-lightning-REST, BTCPay Server or Lightning Terminal) or use the built-in Olympus LNDHub for a quick start, with contacts, Nostr Wallet Connect, LNURL, point-of-sale and full on-chain and Lightning payment support.

apps.name: BlueWallet
apps.description: BlueWallet is a free and open-source Bitcoin wallet focused on simplicity and power. Create standard on-chain wallets, watch-only wallets with full PSBT and hardware-wallet support, and Lightning wallets backed by the built-in LNDHUB or your own node — with fee control, multisig (Vault) and Tor connectivity.

apps.name: Voyager
apps.description: Voyager is a free and open-source client for Lemmy and PieFed with an iOS-native feel — swipe gestures, haptics, infinite scroll, rich markdown support, multi-account switching and deep theming. The same project powers the official Voyager App Store release; this feed tracks the developer's own GitHub build.

apps.name: Saber
apps.description: Saber is a free and open-source handwritten notes app built with Flutter. Write with your finger or Apple Pencil as if on paper, organize notes into folders, keep them private with encryption, and sync across devices using its optional Nextcloud-based sync — no vendor lock-in.

apps.name: Anx Reader
apps.description: Anx Reader is a free and open-source e-book reader for iPhone and iPad. Read EPUB, MOBI and other formats with a polished reader engine, AI-powered summaries and translations (bring your own key), text-to-speech, highlights and notes, reading statistics, and WebDAV sync across devices.

apps.name: Apollo
apps.description: Apollo was the beloved, award-winning Reddit client for iPhone and iPad known for its beautiful native interface, powerful gestures, jump-to-comments, inline media reading and fanatic attention to detail. After Reddit's API changes ended the original app, the Apollo-Reborn project now publishes official continuation builds that work against Reddit's public API — keeping the classic Apollo experience alive.
apps.shortDescription: The beloved Reddit client, continued by Apollo-Reborn

apps.name: DolphiniOS
apps.description: DolphiniOS is the Dolphin GameCube and Wii emulator ported to iOS by OatmealDome, requiring no jailbreak. It runs the full Dolphin core with Metal rendering via MoltenVK, supports controllers, save states and high-resolution rendering, and plays your legally dumped GameCube and Wii games.
apps.shortDescription: GameCube and Wii emulator for iOS

apps.name: iSH
apps.description: iSH is an open-source project that runs a Linux shell environment on iOS using a user-mode x86 emulator. It provides Alpine Linux with the APK package manager, so you can install and run familiar command-line tools — ssh, git, python, vim and more — entirely on your iPhone or iPad, no jailbreak required.
apps.shortDescription: Linux shell on iOS via x86 emulation

apps.name: qBitControl
apps.description: qBitControl is a native qBittorrent remote control app for iPhone and iPad. Manage your torrents from anywhere: add, pause, resume and recheck torrents, browse files and set priorities, configure speed and seeding limits, use custom HTTP headers and self-signed certificates, and track RSS feeds — all against your own qBittorrent WebUI.

apps.name: qBitConnect
apps.description: qBitConnect is a modern, open-source qBittorrent remote client for iPhone and iPad built with Flutter. Connect to your qBittorrent WebUI to add, manage and monitor torrents with a clean, adaptive interface, push notifications for finished downloads, RSS support and quick actions.

apps.name: VCMI
apps.description: VCMI is an open-source engine that re-implements Heroes of Might and Magic III so the classic turn-based strategy game runs on modern hardware — with widescreen and high-resolution support, extensive modding (including the popular HotA and Era mods), stabilized multiplayer and quality-of-life improvements over the original. Requires a copy of the original game's data files.
apps.shortDescription: Open-source Heroes of Might & Magic III engine

apps.name: MAME4iOS
apps.description: MAME4iOS brings the Multiple Arcade Machine Emulator to iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, running thousands of classic arcade games from the 70s, 80s, 90s and beyond. Includes an on-screen joystick, full MFi controller support, netplay, and a menu to organize your legally dumped ROM sets.

apps.name: qBitController
apps.description: qBitController is a free and open-source qBittorrent remote client built with Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose. Control your qBittorrent WebUI from iPhone or iPad: add torrents by URL or file, pause/resume and recheck, browse file lists and set priorities, and manage categories and tags with a clean Material-style interface.

apps.name: Mini vMac
apps.description: Mini vMac for iOS emulates the earliest Apple Macintosh computers (128K, 512K, Plus and II), letting you run classic System 1 through System 7 software on modern devices. Load your own ROM and disk images, with support for external keyboards, mice and multiple emulated machine variants.

apps.name: StikNES
apps.description: StikNES is a Nintendo Entertainment System / Famicom emulator for iPhone and iPad from the StikEMU team, built for modern iOS with Metal-accelerated rendering, MFi and keyboard controller support, save states and a focus on accuracy and low latency. Load your own legally dumped ROMs.

apps.name: TwitchAdBlock
apps.description: TwitchAdBlock is an open-source tweak for the native Twitch iOS app that blocks advert break requests at the network layer, so streams play without ads and without the purple loading screen. This fork by gunnerkidBT keeps the tweak working on the latest Twitch releases (29.x-30.x) and modern iOS versions, and publishes ready-to-sideload IPAs built from the official tweak source.
apps.shortDescription: Ad blocker for the Twitch app on iOS

apps.name: NeoFreeBird
apps.description: NeoFreeBird is a modified build of the official Twitter app that reverts unpopular rebranding and interface changes, restores classic features, and bundles quality-of-life modifications including BHTwitter options — built and published automatically from the project's GitHub releases. Shares com.atebits.Tweetie2 with the App Store Twitter/X app and BHTwitter: install one at a time.
apps.shortDescription: Modified Twitter with QoL fixes and reverts

apps.name: Conduit
apps.description: Conduit is a native, open-source iOS and Android client for Open WebUI, direct OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Ollama and Hermes. Chat with your own self-hosted local models or API-backed ones with a polished SwiftUI interface — conversations stay in sync, code blocks render properly, and your data never touches a third-party server.
apps.shortDescription: Native client for Open WebUI & Ollama

apps.name: Fladder
apps.description: Fladder is a free and open-source Jellyfin frontend built on Flutter, giving you a beautiful Netflix-style interface over your own media library on iPhone and iPad. Direct play and transcode support, offline viewing with sync, multi-server switching, and full library management — no server plugins required.

apps.name: AnymeX
apps.description: AnymeX is an open-source, cross-platform app for streaming anime and reading manga, manhwa, light and web novels, with deep integration for tracking services (AniList, MyAnimeList, Simkl and Kitsu). Extensions keep sources working, and your library, progress and statistics stay in sync across services.
apps.shortDescription: Anime, manga, novels & tracking, open source

apps.name: Sora
apps.description: Sora is a modular, open-source media player for iPhone, iPad and Mac that streams movies and shows from community-maintained modules, with AniList sync, watching collections, watch-next recommendations, bookmarks and a fast native SwiftUI interface. The current build line is distributed as Sulfur.
apps.shortDescription: Modular media streaming app for iOS

apps.name: RainTweak
apps.description: RainTweak injects Rain - the community Discord client mod - into the official Discord iOS app, adding themes, appearance options and quality-of-life fixes on top of a current Discord build. The ready-to-sideload IPA is built and published by the RainTweak project itself, so the download comes straight from the developer's own releases.
apps.shortDescription: Discord client mod with themes and QoL fixes

apps.name: Infuse Plus
apps.description: Infuse Plus (by Dayanch96) enhances the Infuse video player with extra appearance options, app icon choices and playback quality-of-life improvements on top of the stock Infuse 8 app. The build follows the latest Infuse release.
apps.shortDescription: Enhancer tweak for the Infuse video player

apps.name: Glow
apps.description: Glow is a simple, clean and powerful tweak for Facebook by Dayanch96: it removes ads and sponsored content, adds video downloads, unlocks media quality options and hides unwanted UI elements on top of the official Facebook app.
apps.shortDescription: Clean, powerful Facebook tweak by dayanch96

apps.name: Swiftgram
apps.description: Swiftgram is a supercharged, open-source Telegram fork: ghost mode, hide read receipts and online status, save protected media, unlimited account switching and deep interface customization. The project officially ships through the App Store and TestFlight; this entry serves a ready-to-sideload IPA build (Swiftgram base with the MxGram tweak).

apps.name: Telegram MxGram
apps.description: MxGram injects the MxGram tweak into the official Telegram app: ghost mode with per-user exceptions, anti-revoke and anti-edit, saving of protected media, fake GPS, download boost and more, localized in 10 languages.
apps.shortDescription: Official Telegram with the MxGram tweak

apps.name: iQFace
apps.description: iQFace is a tweaked Facebook build with the iQFace tweak by 7MD, one of the Facebook modifications distributed ready-to-sideload through the IPA Vault source. Feature set is defined by the iQFace tweak.

apps.name: RyukGram
apps.description: RyukGram - the Instagram tweak for iOS power users by faroukbmiled - adds media saving, ghost mode, feed cleaning, download buttons and deep customization on top of the official Instagram app.
apps.shortDescription: Instagram tweak for power users by faroukbmiled

apps.name: Sparkle
apps.description: Sparkle (by efibalogh) brings the spark back to Instagram: downloads for reels and stories, ghost mode, ad hiding, restored classic behaviours and UI customization on top of the official Instagram app.
apps.shortDescription: Bring the spark back to Instagram

apps.name: RedditFilter
apps.description: RedditFilter (by level3tjg) filters unwanted content out of your Reddit feed - hide posts by keyword, subreddit, domain, flair or author, natively on top of the official Reddit app. The project publishes a ready-to-sideload IPA with every release.
apps.shortDescription: Filter unwanted content from your Reddit feed

apps.name: NexaSC
apps.description: NexaSC is a community SoundCloud tweak by cielogic: it unlocks SoundCloud Go+ features, removes ads, adds track downloads and can fetch lyrics automatically (via LRCLIB). The tweak is opened by long-pressing the home icon.
apps.shortDescription: SoundCloud Go+ unlock and ad removal (unofficial build)

apps.name: Messenger Flow
apps.description: Messenger Flow is a Facebook Messenger tweak developed by dayanch96. This listing tracks a community-built, ready-to-sideload IPA from IPA Vault, not an official developer IPA. See the upstream project for its feature documentation and the download status for the last known build.
apps.shortDescription: Facebook Messenger tweak by dayanch96 (unofficial build)

apps.name: MSGPlusX
apps.description: MSGPlusX is a tweaked Facebook Messenger build (MessengerPlus lineage by Dens0r and lucaspedrosa), distributed ready-to-sideload through the IPA Vault on a current Messenger base version. The tweak's feature set is defined by its build; no official public documentation exists.
apps.shortDescription: Messenger tweak by Dens0r & lucaspedrosa (unofficial build)

apps.name: ThreadSaver
apps.description: ThreadSaver (by swiftleopard) is a tweaked Threads build distributed ready-to-sideload through the IPA Vault on a current Threads base version. The tweak's feature set is defined by its build; no official public documentation exists.

apps.name: iMe MxGram
apps.description: iMe MxGram is the third-party iMe messenger with the MxGram tweak (by m1ronx1412) injected: ghost mode with per-user exceptions, anti-revoke, saving of protected media and more, on top of the iMe Telegram client.

apps.name: Turrit MxGram
apps.description: Turrit MxGram is the third-party Turrit messenger with the MxGram tweak (by m1ronx1412) injected: ghost mode with per-user exceptions, anti-revoke, saving of protected media and more, on top of the Turrit Telegram client.

apps.name: RyukGram (IG 410)
apps.description: RyukGram (IG 410) is the same enhanced Instagram client ported to the Instagram 410.1.0 app for iOS 15 and later. It carries the full RyukGram feature set — follow-request tracking, read receipts, story-viewer insights, deleted-message logs, device-ID masking, media downloading, custom chat themes and a configurable tab bar — on top of the older Instagram base, which is what you want if the current Instagram builds are unstable on your device or you deliberately stay on an older app version.
apps.shortDescription: RyukGram built on the Instagram 410 app

apps.name: RyukGram Side by Side
apps.description: RyukGram Side by Side is the RyukGram build packaged under its own bundle identifier, com.ryuk.ryukgram, so it installs alongside the real Instagram app instead of replacing it. Both apps get their own name, icon and login, so you can stay signed into a stock account and a modded one at the same time. This variant ships the no-plugin-loader build.
apps.shortDescription: RyukGram under its own bundle id, next to Instagram

apps.name: Dopamine
apps.description: Dopamine is the modern semi-untethered, rootless jailbreak for iOS and iPadOS 15.0 through 26.0.1. It bootstraps a Procursus environment (Sileo and friends) on supported arm64e and arm64 devices, keeps passcode, Touch ID/Face ID and Apple Pay working, and hides its filesystem changes well enough to stay through a userspace reboot. This entry tracks the official Dopamine app the developer publishes on GitHub Releases.

apps.name: Dopamine (RootHide)
apps.description: Dopamine (RootHide) is roothide's hardened Dopamine build for iOS 15.0 through 16.7.x. It runs the jailbreak in a hidden, per-app environment: App Store apps do not see the bootstrap or your tweaks unless you explicitly patch them, and extra work is done to hide jailbreak traces from detection. It keeps the usual Dopamine toolchain — Sileo, rootless tweaks and userspace reboots — under a separate bundle identifier so it can sit next to the stock Dopamine app.
apps.shortDescription: Dopamine fork that hides the jailbreak from apps

apps.name: Bootstrap
apps.description: Bootstrap is roothide's semi-jailbreak bootstrap for iOS and iPadOS 15.0 through 17.0 on A8 to A17 Pro and M1/M2 devices. Instead of jailbreaking the whole system it builds a hidden environment that boots Sileo, Zebra and rootless tweaks while App Store apps stay untouched — so banking, streaming and game apps that refuse to run on a jailbroken device keep working. Apps are patched one at a time when you want tweaks inside them, and the whole environment can be removed again.

apps.name: Serotonin
apps.description: Serotonin is a semi-untethered 'semi-jailbreak' for iOS 16.5.1 through 16.7 RC and iOS 17.0 on arm64e devices. Built on the Fugu15 code base, it gives you tweak injection and a Procursus bootstrap without a full jailbreak: tweaks load into the apps you patch, and the device keeps working normally everywhere else.

apps.name: Taurine
apps.description: Taurine is the Odyssey Team's semi-untethered jailbreak for iOS 14.0 – 14.3 on A9 to A14 devices using the cicuta_virosa and amfid exploits. It installs Sileo and a libhooker-based tweak environment, keeps passcode support, and boots into a userspace jailbreak from the app. Useful for keeping vintage firmwares usable on older iPhones and iPads.

apps.name: Odyssey
apps.description: Odyssey is the Odyssey Team's semi-untethered jailbreak for iOS 13.0 – 13.7 on A9 through A13 devices. It uses the same modern approach as Taurine — libhooker tweak injection, Sileo as the package manager and a userspace jailbreak you re-apply after a reboot — and remains the standard choice for iOS 13 firmwares that unc0ver and checkra1n handle less comfortably.

apps.name: unc0ver
apps.description: unc0ver is the long-running semi-untethered jailbreak by pwn20wnd for iOS 11.0 through 14.8.1. Its final 5.2.0 release covers the widest firmware range of the classic jailbreaks, installing Cydia or Sileo depending on the chosen bootstrap, and it stays useful for the 32-bit era iPhones and iPads that are otherwise stuck without a package manager.

apps.name: SameBoy
apps.description: SameBoy is a highly accurate Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator by LIJI32, ported to iPhone and iPad. It emulates the original hardware closely enough to pass hardware test ROMs, supports Super Game Boy palettes and link-cable emulation between its own instances, ships a built-in debugger, rewinding, save states and cheat support, and lets you import your own ROMs from Files.
apps.shortDescription: High-accuracy Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator

apps.name: Gopeed
apps.description: Gopeed is a modern, open-source download manager written in Go with a Flutter interface. On iOS it handles HTTP/HTTPS, BitTorrent and magnet links, splits downloads into multiple connections, resumes interrupted transfers, and lets you queue and manage everything with upload and download limits. It is the maintained alternative to iTorrent when you want torrents plus ordinary file downloads in the same app.
apps.shortDescription: Modern download manager for HTTP, BitTorrent and more

apps.name: Manic EMU
apps.description: Manic EMU is an all-in-one retro emulator for iPhone and iPad. One app covers NES, SNES, N64, Game Boy and Game Boy Advance, Nintendo DS and 3DS, PlayStation, PSP, Dreamcast, Arcade and more through libretro cores, with a game library that imports your own ROMs, per-core control mapping, cheat support, save states and controller support. The upstream project is AGPL-3.0 and publishes its own signed-for-testing builds.

apps.name: XeniOS
apps.description: XeniOS is an experimental Apple-focused fork of Xenia, the Xbox 360 emulator research project, built for iPhone, iPad and Apple silicon Macs. The iOS build ships as an unsigned IPA and needs recent, powerful hardware: the upstream CMake configuration sets the iOS deployment target to 18.0, and the emulated PowerPC cores plus the Xbox 360 GPU workload only reach playable frame rates on A17 Pro / M-series class chips. It carries the same edge-line core as upstream Xenia and reports game compatibility on xenios.jp. As with every console emulator, you supply your own game files.
apps.shortDescription: Xbox 360 emulation for iPhone and iPad

apps.name: PikaTorrent
apps.description: PikaTorrent is a modern cross-platform BitTorrent client for iOS and Android. Pick a torrent and stream or download it on all your devices, with support for magnet links, .torrent files and pairing with a self-hosted bridge.

apps.name: Thunder
apps.description: Thunder is an open-source, cross-platform Lemmy and PieFed client for iOS and Android built with Flutter. It supports multiple accounts, customizable feeds and gesture-based navigation against any Lemmy or PieFed instance.

apps.name: Chan
apps.description: Chan is a Flutter imageboard browser for iOS and Android. Browse 4chan threads and boards with media galleries, saved posts, pass login and a fast, native-feeling interface.

apps.name: Monal
apps.description: Monal is a free, open-source XMPP (Jabber) instant messenger for iOS and macOS. It offers OMEMO end-to-end encryption, multiple accounts, group chat and push notifications without a central server.

apps.name: JellyBook
apps.description: JellyBook is a nice way to read books and comics from Jellyfin. It streams EPUB, CBZ and PDF titles from your Jellyfin server to your iPhone or iPad with a clean reading interface.

apps.name: Hanami
apps.description: Hanami is an app for reading and saving manga on iOS and iPadOS. It works with self-hosted Komga and Kavita servers and supports offline downloads, library tracking and a fast native reader.

apps.name: Otraku
apps.description: Otraku is an unofficial AniList client for Android and iOS built with Flutter. Browse, search and update your anime and manga lists with a polished native interface.

apps.name: PureKFD
apps.description: PureKFD is an exploit-based jailed package manager for iOS 15.0 through 18.x. It applies Misaka-style tweaks, themes and packages to compatible devices without a full jailbreak.

apps.name: Synkplay
apps.description: Synkplay (Syncplay Mobile) is a Syncplay client for Android and iOS. Watch videos in sync with your friends — playback, pause and seeking are kept synchronized across everyone in the room.

apps.name: Ksign
apps.description: Ksign is a community “cleaner” take on ESign — an iOS app signer and installer. Import IPA files, sign them with your own certificate and install them on device, with Feather-based app-icon styles.

apps.name: Cosmos Music Player
apps.description: Cosmos Music Player is a premium music player for iOS built on iCloud Drive and local storage. It gives you a clean, modern player for the music you keep on your device and in iCloud.

apps.name: AnimeGen
apps.description: AnimeGen is a simple way to enjoy anime art. Generate anime-style images on your device using local AI models, with a gallery and save-to-photos workflow.

apps.name: MuffinStore
apps.description: MuffinStore is a TrollStore app for downgrading App Store apps. It lets you install older versions of apps from the App Store without a jailbreak, shipped as a TrollStore-named .tipa package.

apps.name: Mangayomi
apps.description: Mangayomi is a free, open-source app for reading manga and novels and watching anime, available on Android, iOS, macOS, Linux and Windows. It supports extensions for a wide range of sources.

apps.name: Onside TV
apps.description: Onside TV (formerly Nebulo) is a clean IPTV player for iOS with a built-in sports score centre. Load your own M3U playlists, check the scores, tap a game and it finds the channel showing it on your IPTV service, then watch live channels in a simple, focused interface.
apps.shortDescription: IPTV player with built-in sports scores

apps.name: Chatsen
apps.description: Chatsen is a cross-platform Twitch chat application with third-party addon support. Follow chat in real time with support for BetterTTV, FrankerFaceZ and 7TV emotes and themes.

apps.name: TrollFools
apps.description: TrollFools injects tweaks into apps that are already installed, straight on the device: it performs in-place dylib injection with insert_dylib and ChOma, so no computer and no jailbreak is involved. Upstream documents removable system applications, decrypted App Store apps installed through TrollStore, and encrypted App Store apps patched with a bare dynamic library, plus .deb and .zip tweak packages. Written in SwiftUI, and built on ChOma, MachOKit and insert_dylib.
apps.shortDescription: Inject tweaks into installed apps on-device

apps.name: Lara
apps.description: lara is a jailed customization toolbox that uses the DarkSword exploit to reach the parts of the system iOS keeps locked: a full read/write file manager, a MobileGestalt editor, font / card / custom overwrites, status-bar tweaks, hidden icon labels, an upside-down mode, a five-icon dock, a grid app switcher, a performance HUD, DirtyZero 2, a three-app bypass and a JIT enabler for apps that carry get-task-allow. It is published as its own unsigned IPA for sideloading from the open-source repository.

apps.name: Onion Browser
apps.description: Onion Browser is a free web browser for iPhone and iPad that encrypts and tunnels its traffic through the Tor network with the help of Orbot for iOS. The 3.x branch renders pages with WKWebView instead of the old UIWebView stack, and the project publishes its own sideloadable build next to the App Store release. Open source, with the repository's LICENSE file governing usage and redistribution.
apps.shortDescription: Tor browser that routes web traffic through Tor

apps.name: Orbot
apps.description: Orbot puts an iPhone, iPad or Mac behind the Tor network: it installs a local packet-tunnel configuration so device traffic leaves through Tor instead of the plain network. Obfs4 and Snowflake bridges are supported and fully configurable, Tor v3 onion-service authentication works, and Tor's EntryNodes, ExitNodes, ExcludeNodes and StrictNodes options can all be set. The sideloadable build is published from the project's own GitHub releases, which list the bundled Tor, OpenSSL, Lyrebird and Snowflake versions per app release.
apps.shortDescription: Tor network tunnel for iOS and iPadOS

apps.name: Table Habit
apps.description: Table Habit is a free, open-source habit tracker for building micro habits: a scoring system grades consistency rather than raw streaks, growth charts show the trend, and everything syncs across devices through any WebDAV endpoint - Nextcloud, Koofr or a self-hosted one. Offline-first, no ads, no in-app purchases and no account required, licensed under Apache-2.0. The iOS build OmniSource tracks is the project's own unsigned IPA from its GitHub releases, which AltStore, SideStore, Feather and ESign sign with your certificate at install time.
apps.shortDescription: Open-source micro-habit tracker with WebDAV sync

apps.name: ByeTunes
apps.description: ByeTunes writes MP3, M4A, FLAC and WAV files straight into the iOS media library by talking to the media database directly, so adding a song no longer needs a cable and a desktop sync session. You can create and manage playlists in the app, and import metadata is fetched from iTunes or Deezer. The ringtone injector is disabled upstream for now, so treat ringtones as not working yet. Open source under the MIT license, with the iOS build published from the project's own GitHub releases.
apps.shortDescription: Add music to the iOS library without a computer

apps.name: SNMessenger
apps.description: SNMessenger is a full-featured tweak for Facebook Messenger by NguyenASang, published as a ready-to-sideload IPA built from the official tweak source. Its settings live behind the gear icon in the top-left corner of the Messenger profile screen, which is where every switch is flipped. Upstream documents rootless, rootful and sideload support (Roothide is listed as not supported), iOS 12.4 and newer, and Messenger versions from 458.0.0 up to the latest at release time. Open source under the MIT license.
apps.shortDescription: Messenger tweak with its own sideloaded build

apps.name: BHInstagram
apps.description: BHInstagram is an open-source tweak for Instagram from the developer of BHTwitter, published as a ready-to-sideload IPA. It hides ads and suggested posts, asks for confirmation before likes, shows like counts, lets you copy captions and download videos, save profile pictures, keep deleted messages, and turn off last-seen, screenshot alerts and story view receipts.
apps.shortDescription: Instagram with no ads, downloads and more tweaks

apps.name: Reynard
apps.description: Reynard is an experimental Gecko-based web browser for iOS 13 and up, rendering pages with the same engine Firefox uses instead of Safari's WebKit. It is actively developed and published from the project's own GitHub releases.
apps.shortDescription: Gecko-based browser, a real WebKit alternative

apps.name: Pocket Poster
apps.description: Pocket Poster creates custom, animated Poster Board wallpapers for iOS 17 to 26. Design your own live wallpapers with motion effects - no jailbreak needed.

apps.name: Mugunghwa
apps.description: Mugunghwa is a system-wide icon theming tool for iOS that works without a jailbreak. Change the icons of your apps system-wide, without the per-app icon replacement trick.

apps.name: WDBFontOverwrite
apps.description: WDBFontOverwrite overwrites the system font on iOS using CVE-2022-46689, letting you install custom fonts on iOS 14.0 to 16.1.2 without a jailbreak.

apps.name: TrollInstallerX
apps.description: TrollInstallerX installs TrollStore on compatible iOS devices - arm64 (iOS 14.0 - 16.6.1) and arm64e (iOS 14.0 - 16.5.1) - using the DirtyCow exploit.

apps.name: StatusMagic
apps.description: StatusMagic lets you fully customize the iOS status bar on iOS 14.0 to 16.1.2 without a jailbreak - change fonts, colors and elements to make the status bar yours.

apps.name: CarTube
apps.description: CarTube turns your car's screen into a YouTube streaming hub through CarPlay, on devices running iOS 14.0 to 15.4.1.

apps.name: DynamicCow
apps.description: DynamicCow enables the Dynamic Island on every device running iOS 16.0 to 16.1.2 using the DirtyCow exploit.

apps.name: iTransmission
apps.description: iTransmission is a fast and lightweight BitTorrent client for iOS 13 and up. It downloads and manages torrents and magnet links directly on your iPhone or iPad.

apps.name: Cowabunga
apps.description: Cowabunga is a toolbox for MacDirtyCow devices (iOS 14.0 - 15.7.1 and 16.0 - 16.1.2): a passcode editor, lock-screen footnotes, audio changer, SpringBoard tools and more - customization without a jailbreak.

apps.name: AirTroller
apps.description: AirTroller is an AirDrop spammer/flooder to prank your friends, running on TrollStore and jailbroken iOS 14 and up.

apps.name: Helium
apps.description: Helium adds status-bar widgets to TrollStore iPhones on iOS 14 and up - close the app and the HUD stays on your screen. It also works on jailbroken devices.

apps.name: SecondHand
apps.description: SecondHand adds seconds to the status bar clock on TrollStore devices, with customizable date and time formats.
apps.shortDescription: Seconds in the status bar clock

apps.name: CAPerfHUD
apps.description: CAPerfHUD (Swift) is a Quartz Debug-style performance HUD for iOS - track FPS, CPU and GPU statistics on screen, as a TrollStore build.

apps.name: AppStore++
apps.description: AppStore++ enhances the App Store experience on TrollStore devices - downgrade and upgrade apps and manage your installed apps outside the official store.

apps.name: Nuvio
apps.description: Nuvio is a free, open-source media app for your phone, desktop and the TV you already own. Bring your own sources - Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles and your place saved on every screen.
apps.shortDescription: Open-source media player, bring your own sources

apps.name: EscapeOS
apps.description: EscapeOS is an on-device file browser and app-data backup/restore tool for sideloaded iOS, using a path-scoped container sandbox escape. No jailbreak, no Keychain. Browse an app's Documents, Library and tmp folders, edit or compress files, back up to an archive with a SHA-256 manifest, or reclaim cache space.
apps.shortDescription: App-data browser and backup for sideloaded apps

apps.description: 3105 is a native iOS app-data browser, portable patch manager, limited cleaner and Poster Board wallpaper lab. It intentionally ships under the com.apple.mobile.MobileHouseArrest bundle identifier - the upstream documents that changing it breaks the MHA-C2 app-container workflow.
apps.shortDescription: App-data browser, patch manager and wallpaper lab

apps.name: VibeContainers
apps.description: VibeContainers is a fork of Live Containers that runs jailbroken and tweaked apps on a non-jailbroken iOS 17 or newer device using the LiveContainer JIT. The published release is unsigned - sign it with a tool like AltStore or SideStore before installing.
apps.shortDescription: Jailbreak app runner, a LiveContainer fork

apps.name: Battman
apps.description: Battman is a battery manager for TrollStore and jailbroken iOS devices - battery health, cycle count and temperature, charging limits and a live gas gauge, with a plugin SDK for extra cards.

apps.name: Cercube for YouTube
apps.source: Cercube (cercube.com - official sideload source altstore.cercube.com, jailbreak repo apt.cercube.com)
apps.description: Cercube for YouTube is the official YouTube enhancement from the original Cercube developer, relaunched in 2026: cache media for offline playback, use Picture in Picture and background playback, block supported video, feed and Shorts ads, choose default playback quality separately for Wi-Fi and cellular, reorder or hide tabs, auto-replay, skip sponsored segments, show dislike counts, queue videos - in 14 languages. It hooks the App Store YouTube app. Official distribution: apt.cercube.com (rootful, rootless and roothide jailbreak) and the altstore.cercube.com sideload source for AltStore (Classic), SideStore, Feather, eSign and friends.
apps.shortDescription: Offline, PiP, background play and no ads for YouTube
apps.publisher: Cercube (cercube.com - official sideload source altstore.cercube.com, jailbreak repo apt.cercube.com)

apps.name: Nicegram
apps.description: Nicegram is an independent, open-source messaging client built on the Telegram API (not affiliated with Telegram): manage unlimited accounts on one device, hidden accounts and chats (Double Bottom), built-in AI assistant and in-chat translation, voice-call recording in Saved Messages, quick replies and templates, pre-recorded video messages, a non-custodial Web3 wallet and escrow tools. Official distribution: App Store, TestFlight, and unsigned GitHub-release IPAs signed per the official install guide; this entry tracks the official nicegram/Nicegram-iOS release builds.
apps.shortDescription: Independent Telegram client: multi-account, AI, privacy

apps.name: Battery Info
apps.description: Battery Info is a TrollStore utility from DevelopCubeLab: live charge voltage and current, full capacity, cycle count, temperature and a persistent charging-history database (QMax and limit voltage per charge). The developer also distributes it through the Havoc sideload store (havoc.app/package/batteryinfo).
apps.shortDescription: Battery health, cycles and charge telemetry

apps.name: EnableQUIC
apps.description: EnableQUIC is a TrollStore utility from DevelopCubeLab that switches the network stack onto QUIC where supported, with per-app enable/disable, restore-default-settings (including from backup), configuration-file locking and advanced settings.
apps.shortDescription: Enable QUIC for faster, more resilient networking

apps.name: Animation Speed
apps.description: Animation Speed is a TrollStore utility from DevelopCubeLab that changes the global UI animation speed with a dial (speed range 0-10), with English localization.

apps.name: Eclipse
apps.description: Discover anime, movies, and shows; organize your library; watch with in-app playback; and read manga and light novels. Eclipse supports user-installed Services, Stremio add-ons, SkyStream packages, Nuvio providers, and Reader extensions. Keep track of progress with AniList, MyAnimeList, Trakt, and Simkl, download media for offline use, and back up your settings and library. Cloud sync is optional and off by default. Eclipse does not include media, content sources, or bundled provider add-ons. Install and configure your own sources to watch or read.
apps.shortDescription: Watch, read, and track in one place.
